fraction_definition: xmin + fraction*(xmax-xmin); load minimum is retained so the light-load overhead limit remains exercised.
case_unit: one ngspice process per deck; DC is one load OP; each transient is one full profile including its initial OP; PSRR includes its OP.
policy: Execute all 231 scored cases on one frozen DUT. PSRR, output noise and line response are scored at every group. No separate characterization stage. Failures and partial execution remain explicit; no free retries.
line_coverage: Each group sweeps the same VIN endpoints at its process, temperature, capacitance and highest load; low/high starting VIN groups repeat line trajectories, not distinct coverage.
